ui_bugs.issue: When a page slug already exists (e.g. re-running the QA_Team creation on a persistent test app), the frontend shows 'Could not create page' toast — this is correct API behavior (400 slug already exists) but the toast is generic and doesn't tell the user WHY (duplicate slug). Consider surfacing the backend detail message.

issues: AuthContext still fires /api/auth/me on public /p/<token> and landing routes causing a single 401 console error before login. Cosmetic only, carried from iteration 1/2.

action_items: OPTIONAL LOW: In PagesBar toast, surface the backend error message (e.g. 'Slug already exists') instead of the generic 'Could not create page'.
OPTIONAL LOW (carry-over): Gate AuthContext /api/auth/me call on non-public routes to remove the noisy 401 on /p/<token> and landing.
critical_code_review_comments: studio.py `_clean_theme` silently drops invalid keys — good — but the check 'font in (inter/roboto/arial) resets to default' is odd: those are perfectly valid fonts. Rationale unclear; consider removing this filter or documenting why they are deny-listed.

public_chat writes 2 messages to db.chat_messages with (session_id, token, role, content) but the /public/chat/{token}/history/{session_id} query filters by BOTH session_id AND token. If a client somehow reuses a session_id across different tokens the history endpoint will silently return an empty list — this is defensive but not obvious. Consider a comment or a compound index (session_id, token, created_at).

generate_site() deletes ALL pages before inserting new ones (db.pages.delete_many). There is no transaction; if the second insert loop errors out mid-way, the app ends up with a partial site and no rollback. Wrap in a MongoDB transaction or stage into a temp collection.

OpenAITextToSpeech is instantiated per-request in public_tts even when the cache hits — the cache hit path is fine (it short-circuits before construction) but the client isn't reused across misses. Cache the client at module level.

public_chat inserts both user+assistant messages via insert_many with two now_iso() calls that may resolve to the same microsecond — since sort key is created_at ASC, the user message may sort after assistant on retrieval. Use a monotonic counter or explicit sequence field.
studio.py is 362 lines and mixes pages, theme, ai/site, ai/app, public site, public chat, public tts — approaching the split threshold. Consider studio/pages.py, studio/ai.py, studio/public.py.
